title: Sea Otter Ka Pet Hai Ya Kuan? 🦦 #shorts
idea: Sea otters eat up to 38 percent of their body weight every single day to stay warm in cold ocean waters.

lines.text: Yeh cute jaanwar har din apne wazan ka ek-chauthai khana khata hai!
Ek sea otter har din 25 se 38 percent body weight khata hai!
Yeh ek insaan ke roz 50 thali khana khane ke barabar hai!
Iska metabolism zameen ke jaanwaron se 3 guna zyada tez hota hai.
Thande paani mein body warm rakhne ke liye ise itna khana padta hai.
Agar aapko itna khana mile, toh aap sabse pehle kya khate?

youtube.title: Sea Otter Ka Pet Hai Ya Kuan? 🦦 #shorts
youtube.description:
Did you know sea otters eat up to 38% of their body weight every day just to keep warm? Imagine eating 50 full meals daily!

#seaotter #animalfacts #mindblowingfacts #hinglish #shorts

facts.claim: Sea otters eat 25 to 38 percent of their body weight in food each day.
Sea otters have a metabolic rate 2 to 3 times higher than land mammals.
